title: Cutscenes
description: Cutscene-seen bits for this file: 16 words in the save's own copy (Wii at 0xFB60 with a CRC32, HD at 0x14F20; 0x24 bytes per file). The bit numbering is the same in both formats. skip.dat beside the save mirrors this block and isn't edited here; on Wii, which of the two copies the game reads to allow skipping isn't confirmed. HD offers Skip on unseen cutscenes too.
